display_name: Google Ads conversion and remarketing pixel
description: Google Ads conversion and view-through conversion image pixels, whose conversion ID rides on the path.

params.name: conversion_id
params.description: It is the numeric conversion ID, unique per Google Ads account, and it travels in the path rather than the query.
params.fix_hint: Copy the conversion ID from the conversion action's tag setup.

params.name: label
params.description: It identifies which conversion action fired. Without it, the hit lands on the account rather than on a specific action.
params.fix_hint: Add the conversion label from the conversion action's tag setup.

params.name: currency_code
params.description: It is the ISO 4217 currency of `value`. Google documents it on conversion tags as `currency_code`.
params.fix_hint: Send the three-letter code, such as `USD`.

params.name: ord
params.description: It is the cache buster on the image tag. Google documents a unique `ord` so repeat fires are counted separately.
params.fix_hint: Emit a fresh `ord` on every fire, or drop the empty pair.

params.name: script
params.description: The image fallback sends `script=0` to say no JavaScript ran.
